description: This file defines a Rect class with methods for geometric calculations such as containment, intersection, and creation from various inputs, along with a type for containment results.

classes.name: Rect
classes.description: A class representing a rectangle with methods for geometric operations.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this rectangle is equal to another rectangle.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Determines if a point or rectangle is contained within this rectangle, returning detailed reason if point.

methods.name: intersectsWith
methods.description: Checks if this rectangle intersects with another rectangle.

methods.name: generateNewRect
methods.description: Creates a new rectangle based on provided boundaries or defaults to current rectangle.
